# Photo redactor

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/photo-redactor/

Cover a rectangular part of an image with a solid color and export a flattened PNG. Enter exact pixel coordinates for the area you want to hide.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Hide a phone number or a private message in a screenshot before sharing a copy.

## Limits and checks

Check the exported image carefully. This tool covers one rectangle per export and does not automatically detect sensitive content.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
